headline: The Fed held rates at 3.75-4.00% today, but two officials voted for a hike; bitcoin moved little and traded around $81,000 during the press conference.

market.asOf: Prices read at about 20:00 UTC Wed 28 Oct (03:00 Thursday Bangkok) from the CoinGecko homepage table: BTC $81,414, ETH $2,365, SOL $102.53. CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap showed conflicting 24h changes, so those are left out. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 51 (Neutral) on the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index, up from 48 yesterday and down from 63 (Greed) a week ago. CoinGecko's own separate index shows 48 (Neutral).

stories.title: Fed holds rates, but two officials wanted a hike
stories.summary: The US Federal Reserve kept its key interest rate range at 3.75-4.00% on Wednesday. Two of the twelve voters, Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack, wanted to raise it by a quarter point. Bitcoin moved little on the news and traded around $81,000 during Chair Kevin Warsh's press conference.
points: The vote was 10-2; Cook and Hammack preferred to raise the range by 1/4 percentage point, per the Fed's statement.
The statement says 'Inflation remains elevated.' At his press conference Warsh said third-quarter growth is likely running above 3%, per The National Desk.
CME FedWatch odds of a December rate hike rose to 86% from 78% a day earlier, per CoinDesk, which says the statement's wording means a December hike is not a done deal.
Bitcoin was about $81,100 at 2:33pm ET, per CoinDesk's live blog, after slipping to about $80,600 in the morning.
Earlier on Wednesday the Bank of Canada raised its rate by a quarter point to 2.50%, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Coinbase vendor leak exposed customer contact details, a day before earnings
stories.summary: A security incident at Amplitude, an analytics company Coinbase uses, exposed contact information for some Coinbase customers. Coinbase says it has not had a data breach and found no evidence of unauthorized access to its own systems. A security firm's estimate of more than 70,000 affected users has not been confirmed by Coinbase. Coinbase and Strategy both report quarterly results after the US close on Thursday.
points: 'Coinbase has not had a data breach,' the company's support account said, adding it found no evidence of unauthorized access to Coinbase systems, per crypto.news.
Security firm SlowMist says more than 70,000 users were affected; Coinbase has not confirmed that number, per FinanceFeeds.
Leaked emails and phone numbers are often used for fake 'support' calls and texts: an exchange will never ask for your password, seed phrase or 2FA code.
Coinbase reports after the close on Thursday 29 Oct; analysts expect a loss of about $0.23 a share on $1.21B revenue, per MarketBeat.
Strategy also reports after the close on 29 Oct, with a webinar at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Friday Bangkok), per the company.

stories.title: Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55% from a year ago
stories.summary: Robinhood, a popular trading app, reported third-quarter revenue of $1.42B, but its crypto revenue fell 55% from a year earlier to $120M. Its new prediction-market business brought in more than its crypto trading did. The shares fell after the report.
points: Total Q3 revenue was $1.42B, per The Block.
Crypto revenue fell 55% from a year earlier to $120M, per The Block.
Prediction markets brought in $173M, per The Block.
The shares fell as much as about 10% in the hours after the results, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETFs in, ether ETFs out
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in about $176M on Tue 27 Oct, a second day of inflows, while spot ether ETFs lost about $149M over Monday and Tuesday, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Strategy shareholders back daily dividends
briefs.summary: Preliminary results show about 99.3% of votes in favour of letting Strategy's preferred shares pay dividends daily, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Coinbase adds Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin
briefs.summary: Coinbase listed Ripple's dollar stablecoin RLUSD across its retail app, Exchange and Prime, per The Block; Moody's rated RLUSD A2 this week.

briefs.title: Korean exchange Bithumb reports a breach
briefs.summary: Employee information was exposed in a breach at Bithumb, per accounts of the case; Korean police are checking for links to recent hacks at brokerages, but none has been confirmed, per Seoul Economic Daily.

briefs.title: Midterms could change crypto policy
briefs.summary: Kalshi bettors give Democrats about a 64% chance of winning the Senate next week, and industry voices say the stalled Clarity Act is unlikely to pass in the 'lame duck' session after the election, per The Block.

briefs.title: Treasury's 'Plan B' for crypto rules
briefs.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Treasury could work with the SEC and CFTC on crypto oversight through agency action while Congress has not passed the Clarity Act, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Datavault AI can't withdraw its bitcoin
briefs.summary: Datavault AI stock fell about 50% after the company said it cannot withdraw bitcoin held at the Biconomy exchange, per The Block.
